lyrics:
[Intro: bright glassy guitar chords, soft drum machine]

[Verse 1: breathy, close, almost whispered]
I want you with me when they come
I'll take the blame for what we've done
If they ask, I never knew your name
I'll say it sweetly, all the same

[Pre-Chorus: bass enters, harmonies bloom]
We stole a little time
I'd steal it twice

[Chorus: fuller beat, layered breathy voices]
We're thick as thieves, you and I
Got away, got away with our lives
If they catch us, let them try
I'd do the years and I wouldn't ask why
Thick as thieves
Till the light leaves
Say you'll stay
Don't say you'll leave

[Verse 2: breathy, a little darker]
I'd take the fall, I'd take the weather
Dig a hole and lie in it together
Bury me where you can see the door
I'll wait a hundred years, then more

[Pre-Chorus: bass and harmonies]
We stole a little time
I'd steal it twice

[Chorus: fuller beat, layered breathy voices]
We're thick as thieves, you and I
Got away, got away with our lives
If they catch us, let them try
I'd do the years and I wouldn't ask why
Thick as thieves
Till the light leaves
Say you'll stay
Don't say you'll leave

[Bridge: voice opens up, one long belted high note]
I knew you in another life
You had the same look in your eyes
Oh

[Final Chorus: full, belted ad-libs over breathy layers]
Thick as thieves
Till the light leaves
Say you'll stay
Don't say you'll leave

[Outro: guitar chords, a whisper]
I'd steal it twice
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 105 BPM, 4/4, D major. Gentle, bright and gliding. Sweet on the surface with something darker in the words.

VOICE: Female, very breathy and close, almost whispered, with many soft layers of her own voice in harmony. In the bridge she opens into full chest voice for one long, high, held note, then sings powerful ad-libs over the last chorus before returning to a whisper.

INSTRUMENTS: Bright, glassy, chorus-effected electric guitar chords. A soft drum machine with a light snare and steady hi-hat. A warm, simple synth bass. Shimmering pads. A bell-like synth melody doubling the chorus. No heavy sounds at all.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar and drum machine. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:33 Pre-chorus. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:18 Verse 2. 1:41 Pre-chorus. 1:52 Chorus 2. 2:26 Bridge, building to the long held note at 2:38. 2:48 Final chorus, four lines with ad-libs. 3:08 Outro, guitar chords and a whispered line at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2020s soft pop with a 1980s shimmer: clean, bright and airy, the voice dry and extremely close, everything else slightly distant.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The held high note in the bridge at 2:38, the only loud singing in the song.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: 'Thick as thieves' is a phrase from an older generation. Sung this way it describes a long partnership as well as a new one, and 'got away with our lives' is what two people say after decades.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Tender plotting, devotion with a dark edge, release, a whisper.
